findings.note: VSiN's Adam Burke (Oct 13) priced the Dodgers at -180 and leans Brewers at plus money, saying Milwaukee's league-high walk rate and baserunning are about as tough a matchup as Snell gets; his official pick was Over 7.5 (-106), not a side.

Covers' Quinn Allen picks the Dodgers moneyline in Game 3 (Brewers lead 2-0), backing Snell (1.72 FIP at home) over Gasser, citing Milwaukee's 97 wRC+ vs lefties and LA hitting .312 off Gasser; forecast is clear and 70s.

MLB.com (pre-series) says Ohtani is playing through multiple injuries with a .520 OPS over his past 23 games, and Will Smith went 1-for-16 with 7 strikeouts in the NLDS; its 34 experts split 17-17 on the series.
